places.name: Baga Beach
places.description: The perfect blend of beach action, seafood shacks, and Goa's most iconic nightlife scene.

places.name: Basilica of Bom Jesus
places.description: One of Asia's most revered Catholic basilicas and a pinnacle of Indo-Portuguese Baroque art.
places.mapsSearch: Basilica of Bom Jesus, Old Goa, Goa, India

places.name: Calangute Beach
places.description: Goa's most accessible and lively beach with every amenity a first-time visitor needs.

places.name: Fort Aguada
places.description: The best-preserved Portuguese fort in Goa with commanding 360-degree sea and river views.
places.bestTime: October to March, late afternoon for sunset

places.name: Se Cathedral
places.description: Asia's largest church is a monumental testament to Goa's four-century Portuguese legacy.
places.mapsSearch: Se Cathedral, Old Goa, Goa, India

places.name: Anjuna Beach
places.description: Goa's original counterculture beach, home to the iconic Wednesday Flea Market.
places.bestTime: November to February; Wednesday for the flea market

places.name: Dudhsagar Waterfalls
places.description: One of India's tallest and most spectacular waterfalls, set within dense wildlife sanctuary.
places.bestTime: July to October (monsoon), or October to December

places.name: Palolem Beach
places.description: South Goa's most scenic crescent beach, perfect for families and those seeking a quieter pace.

places.name: Chapora Fort
places.description: The most photogenic fort in Goa, made iconic by Bollywood and blessed with stunning sunset views.

places.name: Vagator Beach
places.description: Goa's most dramatic cliff-beach setting, the heartland of the state's underground music culture.
